evidence: Static decoding of cached class-file bytes and source inspection; no Minecraft or project classes loaded or executed
cloakSnap: Copy old cloak endpoints, calculate independent axis displacements, snap only an axis strictly above 10 or below -10 blocks; otherwise advance that axis by displacement times 0.25
independentState: A cloak snap no longer resets the entire native Simulation or skips that tick's walk, bob and flight updates; wings continue through the separate completed-tick owner
positionEndpoints: Previous/current actor positions remain distinct across a cloak-axis snap
displacementRange: Native sampled motion and Java motion/history validation admit finite offsets up to the 64000000-block span of bounded world endpoints; Java cape-angle clamps remain unchanged
yaw: Native and recorded snapshot sampling use signed float remainder by 360, subtract 360 at >=180, add 360 at <-180, then previous+partial*turn; no preliminary +180 offset
flightArithmetic: Native scale sampling uses the same explicit float square and division order as the Java snapshot sampler
walkArithmetic: Narrow double position differences to float, widen those floats to double for x*x+z*z and square root, narrow the length once, then multiply by 0.6f and add to float walk distance
bobArithmetic: Widen the native float velocity components, take the square root of their double x*x+z*z sum, narrow once and take float min with 0.1f; no hypot substitution
walkAccumulationLimit: Admitted primary-client ticks use ordered observed native finalizations; unavailable/discontinuous batches retain completed-tick endpoint fallback. Equivalence to each Java LocalPlayer.move invocation, worker-thread routes and complete native path coverage remain unverified
